g1-implement.title: G1 systematic-budget module (Tier-1 #2 engine): implement
g1-implement.imperative: Fill IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF for G1. Build src/physics/layer2/systematic_budget.py: a per-session nuisance-uncertainty propagator that, given a session's fitted params (CdA, P_max, a_b, b_b, a_t, b_t, A0, A2) + nuisances (mass_kg, rho, theta_R, pinned-CdA sigma), returns each param's SYSTEMATIC relative sigma SPLIT into (shared_rel, session_varying_rel). Use ANALYTIC sensitivities (CdA and P_max scale ~1:1 with mass; CdA*rho is the constrained product so d ln CdA/d ln rho ~= -1; lateral A0 AND A2 mass/rho CANCEL — A2 is the aero grip slope, treat its systematic like A0 as curvature/terrain-bounded, NOT the blind 4%; name A2 explicitly — cold-critic finding 10). Validate on the CANONICAL session Italy(Monza) RBR 2023 Q (pin it across G1/G3/G4 for end-to-end consistency — finding 9). SHARED = the common-mode nuisances identical across a year's sessions (the quali_mass(year) model bias; the theta_R=0.15 literal used in every de-conflation); SESSION-VARYING = per-session rho measurement error + per-session fuel-load variation about the model. Validate the TOTAL systematic reproduces scripts/nuisance_sensitivity.py's perturbation budget on Monza (Italy) RBR 2023 Q (~4.3% CdA, ~3.7% P_max, braking/traction fit-sigma-dominated). Unit tests (synthetic params, no FastF1) for the split + the analytic-vs-perturbation agreement. Dispatch constellation-implementer. Integrate IMPLEMENTER_RESULT.

g3-implement.title: G3 cross-view covariance population + redundancy demo (Tier-1 #1 NON-DEFERRABLE): implement
g3-implement.imperative: Fill IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF for G3. The redundancy demonstration must be NON-TAUTOLOGICAL and connected to the PERSISTED cross-view terms (cold-critic BLOCKERS 1-3). (1) Expose the already-computed cda_frontier_jacobian J from BrakingView.fit (braking_view.py:242-249) and TractionView.fit on their result dataclasses (BrakingViewResult/TractionViewResult gain a cda_jacobian field). (2) In estimate_store.record_from_estimate, populate cross_view_covariance with cov(CdA,[a_b,b_b]) = sigma_CdA**2 * J_braking and cov(CdA,[a_t,b_t]) = sigma_CdA**2 * J_traction (deterministic, recoverable — x7 map (b) row 2). (3) Fuse the two CdA measurements (PowerDragView descent + CoastView envelope) HONESTLY: they share within-session mass/rho, so they are NOT independent — use G1's systematic budget to get the shared-nuisance correlation and fuse with it (cov-aware, not naive-independent inverse-variance); persist (fused_cda, fused_cda_sigma) in the blob. Report the AGREEMENT z = |cda_pd - cda_coast|/sqrt(sig_pd**2+sig_co**2-2*cov): this is the FALSIFIABLE content — a large-z (>= ~5) disagreement means the two views are inconsistent and the fusion is ILLEGITIMATE (flag it, do not silently fuse). DO NOT change the production pinning CdA (drag_area_closed_m2) — fused is an ADDITIONAL persisted quantity. (4) DEMONSTRATE the redundancy TIGHTENS the BASIS, not just CdA arithmetic: on the CANONICAL session Italy(Monza) RBR 2023 Q (foreground, bounded <=10min; DB paths under C:/Programs/f1Brainz/data/), take the honest fused CdA (tighter than the single-view PowerDrag pin) and PROPAGATE it through the PERSISTED cov(CdA,b_b)/cov(CdA,b_t) to show b_b and b_t effective sigma TIGHTEN vs the single-view-pin baseline — report the before/after on b_b,b_t (the shared params), AND the agreement z (consistency), AND the fused-vs-component CdA sigma. This links the persisted covariance (2) to the tightening (4). Tests: cross-view terms populated non-trivially + reload; the cov-aware fused sigma is correct on a synthetic fixture where the two measurements are CORRELATED (naive-independent would understate it — assert the cov-aware sigma is >= the naive one); a 5σ-disagreement synthetic case flags illegitimate-fusion. g4-implement.title: G4 sigma-honesty wiring + explicit-unknown semantics (Tier-1 #2 wiring + #3): implement
g4-implement.imperative: Fill IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF for G4. (1) Replace the static SYSTEMATIC_FLOOR in estimate_store.py with the G1 systematic_budget per-session computation: each stored {axis}_sigma folds in the per-session systematic TOTAL (fit-sigma + systematic in quadrature); persist the SHARED component per axis (a new {axis}_shared_sigma slot in the record) so pooling can floor on it. Before removing SYSTEMATIC_FLOOR, grep the tree for every importer/usage of the symbol and migrate them (cold-critic finding 11). (2) Add a shared-systematic floor to pooling.pool_random_effects (new shared_floor arg) and thread it through pool_driver.pool_store: after DerSimonian-Laird shrinks sigma_mu, floor it -> sigma_mu = sqrt(sigma_mu**2 + shared_floor**2) so pooling CANNOT shrink the correlated-shared systematic away. The floor MUST be wired non-optionally at the pool_store site: pool_store always passes the per-param shared floor (from the store's {axis}_shared_sigma) — add a test that the wired path floors and that omitting the floor is caught, so no call site silently regresses to unfloored (finding 5). The floor is WITHIN-YEAR (matches pool_store's load(year=...) within-year pooling); cross-year mass-model drift is a separate axis (fit_drift) — document as out-of-scope (finding 14). Demonstrate on the CANONICAL Italy(Monza) RBR 2023 Q season load: pooled sigma_mu for CdA and P_max no longer drops below the shared floor as n grows (before/after number). (3) Explicit-unknown semantics: set {axis}_status='resolved' when the axis was genuinely measured this session (finite non-degenerate sigma from real data); 'unresolved' for theta_R (only a cold constant, never measured into the basis), a degenerate PowerDrag CdA/P_max, and any absent (None) lateral/coast view (covers A0/A2 when lateral is absent) — each persisting the reserved wide sigma (the G2 sentinel), NOT a confident ~0. (4) Lateral A0 AND A2: use G1's curvature/terrain-bounded systematic, not the blind 4% (finding 10). (5) BACKWARD-COMPAT beyond tests: the {axis}_sigma numeric distribution now shifts (per-session systematic replaces flat 4%; A0/A2 off the blind 4%). Characterize the weekend_state gate DECISIONS (gate_f6/floor/gate_spec) before/after on a fixture and confirm no UNINTENDED decision flips, or document the expected shift (finding 8). Tests: (a) property test — theta_R + a degenerate/absent axis read 'unresolved' with reserved wide sigma; a measured CdA reads 'resolved' (numerically distinct from confident-zero); (b) pooled sigma_mu floored by shared systematic (does not shrink below it as n grows); (c) the pool_store wiring passes the floor (no silent-unfloored path). WORKTREE-ISOLATION as G3 (canonical Italy RBR 2023 Q). Dispatch constellation-implementer. Integrate.
